row.body: Rowan 2026-11-26: many homepage ideas read as fantasy; all product, no pitch. Kept What Works, Replication Ledger and Unlearn; retired 13. build_idea_bank.py refuses ideas without a probed example; liveclaims blocks future-feature wording and unprobed hosts; humanvoice blocks hype words.
